name: create_batch
title: Create a batch from a product link
description: Read a public product, website or app store page and write a brief plus the first 10 posts (part 0) in your account. Free, up to 20 links a day. Does not spend credits; open the app link to unlock all 100 posts and render the files.

url.description: Public product, website or App Store / Google Play link

annotations.title: Create a batch from a product link

name: get_batch
title: Read a post batch
description: Read one of your batches: the product brief, every written part with its posts (slideshow slides, reaction-hook beats, meme captions, plus caption and hashtags for each), which parts are locked, product image links and the public links of renders you saved in the app.

batchId.description: Batch id from list_batches or create_batch

name: get_profile
title: Read your UGCHooks profile
description: Read the signed-in customer's own UGCHooks account profile. Does not search for or identify other people.

name: list_batches
title: List your post batches
description: List your newest 100 UGCHooks batches (one per product link) with product name, host, whether all 100 posts are unlocked and an app link.

name: write_part
title: Write a part of a batch
description: Write (or re-read) part 0 to 9 of one of your batches: 10 posts each. Parts 1 to 9 need the batch to be unlocked in the app first. Already written parts are returned unchanged.

batchId.description: Batch id from list_batches or create_batch

annotations.title: Write a part of a batch
